text: Enclosed are copies of letters from two candidates that returned the Miller check. Both
candidates were elected, but as the tone of their letters indicate, I think we will do just fine
with them as legislators. I supported both candidates with multiple sources and feel I will
have a good relationship with them.
On a positive note, I am enclosing a copy of the thank you letter from Ken Strobeck. Ken
wants to chair the Revenue Committee. He also wanted you to know that he expressed
Best wishes for a great beginning with you new family!
